# KPE Archive — Korean Photo Essay Showcase

> A bilingual (English/Korean) photo-essay series by Hong Sahn (HongSahn Media) on Korean heritage spaces — palaces, temples, hanok villages, royal tombs and parks — around time, memory and impermanence. Season I: Coming and Going Time, 30 volumes.

This showcase is the open layer of the archive: for each volume, the Prelude and one scene per episode, with the photograph, a bilingual description, place, year, coordinates, mood tags and narration. The full essays, verses and photographs are in the books.

## AI access

- [MCP server](https://kpe-archive.paulsb1961.workers.dev/mcp): remote MCP (Streamable HTTP), no sign-in, read-only. Tools: list_volumes, get_volume, search_scenes.
- [Volume list (JSON)](https://paulsb1961-star.github.io/kpe-showcase/data/volumes.json): titles, places and the data file of each volume
- Volume data (JSON): https://paulsb1961-star.github.io/kpe-showcase/data/KPE_VolNN_Showcase.json (NN = 01–30)
